title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Month Relief - Accounting Note
content:
**Accounting note - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve.**

## The calculation

The recall month relief is nothing: no day of the latest-billed month is counted, nothing is withdrawn per day, and the result is rounded to the cent.

## Terms

- **Month concerned.** The latest-billed month, the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date. The relief arises only where that is a later month than the most recently paid month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles); where the two are the same month the relief is 0.00.
- **The bill.** The monthly bill of the latest-billed month: the amount billed for that month and the days the bill covers.
- **Assembly.** The recall month relief is the number of counted days, from the first day counted through the last day counted, multiplied by the daily amount withdrawn; it is rounded to the cent once, at the end, and is never less than zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only plan: May paid, June billed at 614.07 for 30 days. No day of June is counted and nothing is withdrawn per day, so the recall month relief is 0 days multiplied by 0.00, that is 0.00.
